name: Icon Search · home SVG Icons

title.zh: Icon Search · 搜图标再沿原图源核许可

description.zh: 比较房屋的描边和轮廓，再点原图源核许可。 聚合不同图源的图标检索入口，按关键词提供图形预览和原始来源链接。官网 FAQ 指向的 logosearch 网站代码已实际读取，按 AGPL 第三版授权；图标和标志仍属原权利人，价格、单图许可与商业使用条件须逐项核对。
description.en: An icon search entry combining different image sources, with keyword previews and links to originals. The logosearch website repository linked by its FAQ was read and carries the AGPL version-three license. Icons and logos remain their original owners’ property; prices, individual image licenses, and commercial permissions require separate checks.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Icon Search (https://iconsear.ch/search.html?q=camera).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 比较房屋的描边和轮廓，再点原图源核许可。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先从常用名称表打开 home，对照线框、实心和像素轮廓，再核对图样的原图源链接。建议用 Search 换个名称缩小范围，选图时同时看对应来源，网站统计仍须另行核验。这个入口适合跨库找同类图标，网站代码按 AGPL 第三版公开，但不覆盖聚合图稿；价格和原图许可仍需逐项确认，不热链图片。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.scope: Icon Search 官网FAQ直接source code href与GitHub官方仓库元数据一致，README同时明确LogoSear.ch与IconSear.ch。
